title: fix-network commands
description: The two subcommands of the fix-network binary, with fix --dry-run as a third way in because it changes nothing.

entities.name: diagnose
entities.description: Takes one snapshot, judges every dimension and prints the checks, the findings with their outcomes, what was not verified and whether a Wi-Fi reset is required.
entities.transport: Command line (also as zazzle fix-network ...): fix-network diagnose [--internal-host HOST[:PORT]]... [--json] [-v]
entities.authorization: Nothing is checked. It runs as the calling user and never uses sudo; its only writes are the run's own state directory.
entities.result: The report on stdout (or, with --json, the whole run as one JSON document), the same lines in diagnostic.log, and exit status 0 when no dimension failed, else 1.
failures: Not macOS: 'error: fix-network works on macOS only' on stderr, exit status 2, nothing run.
The state directory cannot be created: 'error: cannot create state directory' on stderr, exit status 1.
An --internal-host that parse_target rejects (bad port, missing ], empty host): clap's usage error, nothing run.

entities.name: fix --dry-run
entities.description: Diagnoses as diagnose does, then prints the steps a fix would start with: the --force ladder first when --force is given, then the findings' steps least disruptive first, each marked with the flag that would block it.
entities.transport: Command line (also as zazzle fix-network ...): fix-network fix --dry-run [fix flags] [--internal-host HOST[:PORT]]... [--json] [-v]
entities.authorization: Nothing is checked and no step runs; the flags only decide which planned steps are marked as skipped.
entities.result: The report and the plan ('nothing to run' when empty); exit status 0 when no dimension failed, else 1.
failures: The state directory cannot be created: exit status 1.

entities.name: fix
entities.description: Repairs adaptively: runs the least disruptive allowed step, takes a fresh snapshot, assesses again and repeats until healthy or nothing more is allowed; then, if any step ran, waits 15 seconds and verifies every dimension again.
entities.transport: Command line (also as zazzle fix-network ...): fix-network fix [--vpn] [--fix-proxy] [--allow-route-flush] [--allow-remote] [--force] [--internal-host HOST[:PORT]]... [--json] [-v]
entities.authorization: Gated steps need their flag: --vpn to reconnect a VPN, --fix-proxy to disable proxies, --allow-route-flush to flush routes. Over SSH, steps that can cut the session need --allow-remote (Gates::blocked). Privileged steps run through sudo, which asks in the terminal, or fails as sudo -n when there is none (sys::argv).
entities.result: The final report, the actions with ok or FAILED and the reason, and exit status 0 when no dimension failed after the repair, else 1.
failures: A step's command exits non-zero or networksetup prints '** Error': the step is recorded as FAILED with the command and its first line of output, and the loop moves on to the next step.
Every remedy needs a flag or manual action: no step runs, the log says so, and the findings name the missing flags.
A VPN does not reach Connected within its polls: FAILED, and the finding falls back to manual advice (sign-in or MFA from the menu bar).
Twelve rounds pass without a healthy report: the loop stops (MAX_ROUNDS).
Not macOS: exit status 2. The state directory cannot be created: exit status 1.
